title: Topology-dependent DNA binding
authors: Pauline J. Kolbeck; Miloš Tišma; Brian T. Analikwu; Willem Vanderlinden; Cees Dekker; Jan Lipfert
one_liner_zh: 该文通过定量模型和实验研究DNA拓扑结构对配体（如嵌入剂）结合的影响，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属于广义蛋白/配体-DNA互作且涉及结合动力学与结构调控，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: DNA stores our genetic information and is ubiquitous in biological and biotechnological applications, where it interacts with binding partners ranging from small molecules to large macromolecular complexes. Binding is modulated by mechanical strains in the molecule and, in turn, can change the local DNA structure. Frequently, DNA occurs in closed topological forms where topology and supercoiling add a global constraint to the interplay of binding-induced deformations and strain-modulated binding. Here, we present a quantitative model of how the global constraints introduced by DNA topology modulate binding and create a complex interplay between topology and affinity. We focus on fluorescent intercalators, which unwind DNA and enable direct quantification via fluorescence detection. Using bulk measurements, we show that DNA supercoiling can increase or decrease intercalation relative to an open topology depending on ligand concentration and the initial topology. Our model quantitatively accounts for observations obtained using psoralen for UV-induced DNA crosslinking, which is frequently used to quantify supercoiling in vivo . Finally, we observe topology-dependent binding in a single-molecule assay, which provides direct access to binding kinetics and DNA supercoil dynamics. Our results have broad implications for the detection and quantification of DNA and for the modulation of DNA binding in cellular contexts.
abstract_zh: DNA储存着我们的遗传信息，并在生物及生物技术应用中普遍存在，它与从分子到大型大分子复合物等各类结合伙伴相互作用。结合受到分子中机械应变的调节，反过来又能改变局部DNA结构。通常，DNA以闭合拓扑形式存在，其中拓扑结构和超螺旋为结合诱导的变形与应变调节的结合之间的相互作用增加了全局约束。在此，我们提出了一个定量模型，阐述DNA拓扑引入的全局约束如何调节结合，并创造拓扑与亲和力之间的复杂相互作用。我们聚焦于荧光嵌入剂，它们能解开DNA，并通过荧光检测实现直接定量。利用批量测量，我们表明DNA超螺旋相对于开放拓扑结构，可以增加或减少嵌入，具体取决于配体浓度和初始拓扑状态。我们的模型定量解释了使用补骨脂素进行紫外线诱导DNA交联所观察到的结果，该方法常用于体内超螺旋定量。最后，我们在单分子实验中观察到拓扑依赖性结合，这直接提供了结合动力学和DNA超螺旋动态的信息。我们的结果对DNA的检测与定量以及细胞环境中DNA结合的调节具有广泛意义。
